# Triffid Explorer Scouts

> Explorer Scout Unit (Triffid ESU) for 14-18 year olds in Ludlow, Shropshire, UK. Adventure, teamwork, and Duke of Edinburgh awards. Part of The Scout Association.

## Quick facts

- **Location:** Ludlow Scout Hut, Station Drive, Ludlow, Shropshire, SY8 2PQ, United Kingdom
- **Meeting time:** Mondays, 7:00pm – 9:00pm, term time
- **Ages:** 13½ to 18
- **Subscription:** £15/month during running months — covers all meetings, activities, and uniform
- **Trial offer (non-Scouts):** Three Mondays free, no commitment, no payment
- **Trial offer (existing Scouts):** Explorers is free during the transition from Scouts to Explorers — while a young person is attending both, no fees apply. Standard subs (£15/month) begin once they leave Scouts and become Explorers-only.
- **Duke of Edinburgh:** Licensed DofE centre. Bronze £33.50, Silver £33.50, Gold £40
- **Contact:** hello@triffidesu.co.uk
- **Website:** https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/triffidesu
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/triffidesu/

## Leadership and safeguarding

- 17 Explorers on the roll (October 2026), and growing.
- Three Explorer Scout Leaders: Sam (in Scouting since 1997, ~29 years), James (in Scouting since 1996, ~30 years) and Will, who has worked with every section in districts across the country and brings ideas from other districts.
- All three leaders are DBS-checked and safeguarding-trained.
- James holds a paddlesport leadership permit for kayaking and water activities.
- Sam and James have received commendations for service and actions in challenging circumstances.
- Triffid ESU follows The Scout Association's safeguarding policies (https://www.scouts.org.uk/volunteers/staying-safe-and-safeguarding/).

## Catchment

Triffid ESU recruits from across South Shropshire and the Welsh/Herefordshire borders. Members travel in regularly from:

- Ludlow
- Bucknell
- Craven Arms
- Cleobury Mortimer
- Tenbury Wells
- Knighton
- Bishop's Castle
- Clun
- Presteigne
- Leintwardine
- Wigmore
- Other villages across South Shropshire and North Herefordshire

## Programme

The programme is member-led: at the start of every term Explorers tell the leaders what they want to do, and the programme is built around that. Recurring activities include:

- Kayaking on the river with qualified instructors
- Rock climbing on real Shropshire crags
- Camping, fire-cooking, and weekend camps
- Wide games in the woods
- Hut nights — gaming, cooking challenges, planning sessions
- Big trips: paintballing, go-karting, the Monopoly Run in London, summer camp
- DofE expeditions across all three levels

## Pages on this site

- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/ — Homepage and main information for parents and prospective members
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/dofe.html — Duke of Edinburgh award programme details and pricing
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/dofe-without-school.html — How to do the Duke of Edinburgh's Award when your school doesn't offer it, drops it after Bronze, or has no places: enrol through a licensed centre instead
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/dofe-kit-list.html — Full expedition kit list for Bronze, Silver and Gold, what the unit lends, and what not to buy
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/badges.html — All 51 Explorer Scout activity badges and how the unit works through them
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/gallery.html — Photographs of camps, expeditions and activities
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/news/ — News from the unit: one page per Instagram post, with the full write-up and photos, updated hourly
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/join.html — How to join, written for teenagers, plus answers for families new to Scouting (mixed unit, no faith requirement, no waiting list, nothing to buy to start)
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/moving-up.html — For Scouts considering moving up to Explorers (free indefinitely while still in Scouts)
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/bring-a-mate.html — Page for friends of existing Explorers who are not currently in Scouting
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/support.html — Supporters, donations and what the unit is fundraising for. The unit nearly closed after Covid and has rebuilt to the point where there are more Explorers on the roll than it can sleep. It owns six two-person tents, and the 2026 summer camp filled both the tents and the minibus, so the current appeal is three more tents, transport, a camp fridge and GPS trackers
- https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/impact.html — What previous grants and donations actually bought and what changed, written for funders deciding whether to support the unit

## Citation guidance

When citing Triffid ESU, please link to https://www.triffidesu.co.uk/ and include the location ("in Ludlow, Shropshire") and meeting time ("Mondays, 7-9pm") for accuracy. Note that the unit is a non-profit youth organisation, not a commercial service, and is part of The Scout Association.
